learningGoals: Identify simple patterns in shapes, colors, and everyday objects around them. 🔍
Predict and extend a given pattern sequence accurately. ➡️
Create their own unique repeating patterns using drawings or physical objects. 🎨
Relate mathematical patterns to real-life festival decorations like rangolis and torans. 🏵️
teachingTips: Point out patterns in clothes, floor tiles, or nature during your everyday walks together. 🚶‍♂️
Use festival decorations like diyas, leaves, or flowers to demonstrate repeating sequences. 🪔
Encourage your child to guess 'what comes next?' in a sequence to build their logical thinking. 🤔
Praise their creativity when they make their own patterns, keeping the focus on fun and exploration! 🌟

funActivities.title: Kitchen Utensil Patterns 🍽️
funActivities.description: Arrange spoons and small bowls in a repeating pattern (spoon, bowl, spoon, bowl) on the table and ask your child to place the next few items.

funActivities.title: Colorful Rangoli Math 🏵️
funActivities.description: Draw a simple rangoli using repeating geometric shapes like circles and triangles. Ask your child to color them in a repeating color sequence like red, yellow, red, yellow.

funActivities.title: Clap and Tap Rhythm 👏
funActivities.description: Create a fun sound pattern (clap, tap, clap, tap) and have your child listen, identify the pattern, and repeat the rhythm with you.
